confirmed_bugs.title: Workspace session cookie drops the server URL prefix
confirmed_bugs.expected: A cookie minted through a prefixed server URL authenticates the prefixed workspace file URL.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Cookie Path is <redacted:session-cookie> regardless of root_path. The browser-like cookie jar gets 401 at /qa-f02-prefix<redacted:session-cookie>/{id}/workspace/qa-f02.html; the same valid cookie gets 200 at the unprefixed URL.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Known map bug reproduced at the marked assertion in both fresh attempts. Header-authenticated prefixed URL and cookie-authenticated unprefixed URL are successful controls. No model needed. Source: auth_router.py cookie Path ignores root_path.

confirmed_bugs.title: IPv6 loopback workspace cookies omit Secure and Partitioned
confirmed_bugs.expected: Host [::1]:8000 receives SameSite=none; Secure; Partitioned, matching localhost and 127.0.0.1.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The IPv6 Host request returns 204 with SameSite=none but omits Secure and Partitioned, so browsers reject the cookie. The two IPv4/localhost controls include both flags.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Known map bug reproduced twice. The test changes the HTTP Host header to IPv6 loopback while reaching the same loopback server; it does not claim an IPv6 network bind test. Source: auth_router.py:42-65 splits request.url.hostname on ':' before loopback matching.

confirmed_bugs.title: Deferred init accepts CORS origins but leaves the boot allowlist unchanged
confirmed_bugs.expected: The allow_cors_origins delivered by successful POST /api/init authorizes that origin on a CORS preflight.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The delivered https://qa-f03.example gets 400 Disallowed CORS origin and no Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Localhost control gets200; an undelivered origin also gets400.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Known map bug at marked assertion in both fresh attempts. CORSDispatcher captures config.allow_cors_origins when create_app runs; successful init updates the config but does not rebuild middleware.

confirmed_bugs.title: Conversation create executes an initial message with run=false
confirmed_bugs.expected: Persist the initial message and remain idle with no model run when initial_message.run is false.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The false request runs to finished on the controlled provider just like the true control.
confirmed_bugs.notes: The live recipe checks the persisted user message, then observes execution starting/finishing. The create schema advertises run=false, but _start_conversation unconditionally calls run(). Supplemental GET reports finished and exactly one ActionEvent on both fresh attempts.

confirmed_bugs.title: Start-time secrets disappear from the immediate conversation GET
confirmed_bugs.expected: GET immediately lists the start-time StaticSecret that the create response lists, masked.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Create lists QA_F 04_TOKEN; the immediate GET returns an empty secret_sources map.
confirmed_bugs.notes: The secret exists in live memory but is absent from the autosaved base_state snapshot until a later state save.

confirmed_bugs.title: Plain-string create secrets cause an unhandled server error
confirmed_bugs.expected: Accept the plain-string secret like the secrets update route, or reject it with 422.
confirmed_bugs.actual: POST <redacted:session-cookie> returns 500: 'str' object has no attribute 'pop'.
confirmed_bugs.notes: This is a malformed-input/status-only defect. Synthetic QA values are used; no real secret is posted in the negative test.

confirmed_bugs.title: A conversation batch of 100 IDs returns 500 instead of a client error
confirmed_bugs.expected: Refuse 100 IDs with 400/422 naming the limit.
confirmed_bugs.actual: A batch of 100 well-formed UUIDs returns 500 with an empty exception string.
confirmed_bugs.notes: batch_get_conversations uses assert len(ids)<100 instead of request validation; the ordinary 99-ID control is covered by the primary full family.

confirmed_bugs.title: Whitespace title passes validation and erases the title
confirmed_bugs.expected: Reject a whitespace-only title with 422 and retain the existing title.
confirmed_bugs.actual: PATCH with a whitespace-only title returns 200; a subsequent GET reports title="" on two fresh supplemental runs.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Metadata defect: validation checks min_length before stripping. Acceptance and persisted title erasure are both independently proven twice.

confirmed_bugs.title: PATCH on a missing conversation contradicts its documented 404
confirmed_bugs.expected: PATCH returns 404 for the same missing ID that GET returns 404 for.
confirmed_bugs.actual: PATCH returns 200 with success=false despite the OpenAPI 404 response declaration.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Status-contract defect; the source test currently locks the 200 behavior.

confirmed_bugs.title: DELETE on a missing conversation contradicts its documented 404
confirmed_bugs.expected: DELETE returns 404 for a missing or already-deleted conversation.
confirmed_bugs.actual: DELETE on an absent ID returns 400, and a second DELETE after successful deletion also returns 400, despite the documented 404.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Both the never-created and already-deleted branches reproduced twice.

confirmed_bugs.title: Rich exception rendering stalls the entire agent server
confirmed_bugs.expected: Health and event-count probes remain below 1.5 seconds while a model-provider failure is handled.
confirmed_bugs.actual: A positive-control /alive request took 67 ms; a failure-time probe took 4,512 ms. The second fresh attempt recorded 10,909 ms, while the request before the failure met the 1.5-second threshold.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Default console logger.exception renders a large Rich traceback synchronously on the event loop. LOG_JSON=true or LOG_RICH_TRACEBACKS=false is the documented workaround; production Docker uses JSON logging.

confirmed_bugs.title: Pause/interrupt on an unknown conversation use undocumented 400
confirmed_bugs.expected: Both pause and interrupt return their documented 404 for a missing conversation.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Both pause and interrupt return 400 for an absent valid UUID, despite GET returning 404 and both OpenAPI routes documenting 404.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Each method reproduced twice. Status-only defect.

confirmed_bugs.title: A mid-call pause is invisible to GET and lost on crash recovery
confirmed_bugs.expected: GET agrees with the accepted paused state; after SIGKILL/restart the accepted pause remains paused.
confirmed_bugs.actual: During an accepted mid-call pause, status search and PauseEvent say paused, but GET and base_state.json say running. After SIGKILL, lease expiry, and restart, both PauseEvents remain but GET reports error.
confirmed_bugs.repro_command:
control-agent-server map run --file F05 --only F05.run-error,F05.run-error-responsive,F05.unknown-id-pause,F05.run-conflict,F05.pause-running,F05.pause-running-get,F05.pause-running-release,F05.restart-running-graceful,F05.restart-hard-running,F05.pause-running-crash --fresh --repeat 2 --record --keep-going --timeout 420
.venv/bin/python /workspace/verification-artifacts/adapted-f05/run-adapted-f05.py map run --file F05 --only F05.restart-running-graceful,F05.restart-hard-running,F05.pause-running-crash --fresh --repeat 2 --record --keep-going --timeout 420
confirmed_bugs.notes: One root cause across GET, disk snapshot, and crash recovery: autosave is deferred while model I/O holds save_depth open. In this PID-1 container the killed owner remains a zombie; the adaptation verifies that state, records the remaining owner-lease TTL, waits for expiry, and restarts before the target assertion. Instantaneous dead-owner recovery is not certified.

confirmed_bugs.title: Documented short event kinds silently return empty results
confirmed_bugs.expected: kind=MessageEvent returns the two user messages, matching their wire kind and the TypeScript client contract.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The fully qualified MessageEvent filter finds two messages; the documented short kind returns an empty search and count 0. Both routes independently reproduce twice.
confirmed_bugs.notes: The service compares module.ClassName rather than the documented wire kind; TypeScript clients following the documentation silently lose history.

confirmed_bugs.title: One absent event crashes get-one and batch history reads
confirmed_bugs.expected: Get-one returns 404 for a missing ID; a mixed batch preserves known events and returns null for the missing slot.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Get-one returns 500 for an absent event ID; a batch containing one valid event and one absent event also returns 500 instead of [event, null]. Both branches reproduce twice.
confirmed_bugs.notes: EventLog.get_index raises KeyError before the router can return 404/null; an absent item aborts the whole batch.

confirmed_bugs.title: A schema-valid non-user message causes 500
confirmed_bugs.expected: Reject assistant-role input with 4xx and append no events, including on an empty log.
confirmed_bugs.actual: An assistant-role POST returns 500 on both initialized and empty logs. The rejected POST to an empty log also persists a SystemPromptEvent, leaving count 1 instead of 0.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Role is schema-valid but LocalConversation asserts user. Both response and empty-log mutation branches reproduced twice. Count remains one low-severity malformed-input bug.

confirmed_bugs.title: Timestamp-based event resume skips delayed stats updates
confirmed_bugs.expected: A timestamp cut at an observation keeps that observation and every later-listed event in REST and WebSocket replay.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The marked REST count is lower than the number of events listed from the observation onward.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Stats updates are timestamped at model response time, then appended after tool observations; both REST count and legacy socket replay skip a subsequently appended stats event. Replay and unsorted-timestamp assertions separately reproduced twice using real DeepSeek file-editor turns.

confirmed_bugs.title: Deleting a conversation leaves its event/session sockets open
confirmed_bugs.expected: DELETE closes already subscribed sockets before answering; subsequent reads are 404 and new sockets 4004.
confirmed_bugs.actual: DELETE succeeds, REST returns 404 and a new socket 4004, but the existing capture remains open with close=null.
confirmed_bugs.repro_command:
control-agent-server map run --file F06 --only F06.send-no-run,F06.search-kind-short,F06.get-one,F06.unknown-event,F06.send-non-user-role,F06.ws-delete-close,F06.search-timestamp-order --fresh --repeat 2 --record --keep-going --timeout 420
control-agent-server map run --file F07 --only F07.live-order,F07.deleted-close --fresh --repeat 2 --record --keep-going --timeout 420
confirmed_bugs.notes: The legacy events and session protocols reproduce independently twice. Subscriber.close does not close the WebSocket, leaving connected clients waiting after successful DELETE. This is a socket/task leak; no OS process orphan is claimed.

confirmed_bugs.title: Out-of-order durable frames can make a session cursor lose a message
confirmed_bugs.expected: The first user message yields durable seq 0,1,2 in order, matching persisted log order.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The live socket emits 0,2,1: last_user_message_id is published before the user message at seq 1.
confirmed_bugs.notes: A client saving the highest sequence and disconnecting after 2 resumes past the missing message. Replay itself is ordered; the message remains on disk.

harness_map_issues.title: Some F05/F06 isolated recipe selections omit state prerequisites
harness_map_issues.actual: Requires clauses omit earlier recipes whose variables or conversation state are consumed. Repro selections explicitly include the prerequisite IDs; shared files were not changed.

harness_map_issues.title: Cold OpenAPI generation exceeded doctor timeout under concurrent load
harness_map_issues.actual: The first doctor had only the OpenAPI check fail with ReadTimeout. After cache warmup the identical doctor was clean, with health/auth/build checks and no log tracebacks. Treat as transient timing; not counted as a product bug.

harness_map_issues.title: Shared overlay filled during verification
harness_map_issues.actual: ENOSPC interrupted first primary F02 and first F04 repro save_evidence; empty F04-F07 repro summaries followed. Existing F01, F02-repro and F03-repro summaries were valid. After space restoration the incomplete families were restarted, preserving prior evidence. No bug conclusion uses ENOSPC attempts.

harness_map_issues.title: Hard-restart lease checks encounter unreaped PID-1 zombies
harness_map_issues.actual: Original crash recipes fail before the target pause assertion because os.kill(owner_pid, 0) still succeeds for the killed zombie process. The recipe copy waits the recorded lease TTL and restarts; ordinary running recovery then passes and pause-loss reproduces.

blocked.actual: unshare: cannot open /proc/self/uid_map: Read-only file system. It failed before launching the server.
blocked.notes: This is blocked by the execution environment, not an agent-server bug. The primary JSON retains the raw fail; the evidence ledger has a later blocked judgment.

blocked.prerequisite: A host that reaps the killed server PID before the immediate recovery assertion
blocked.attempted: Original immediate SIGKILL/restart dead-owner takeover recipe
blocked.actual: The container leaves the owner PID as a zombie and os.kill(pid, 0) treats it as alive. Recovery after recorded lease expiry and a further restart is proven twice; instantaneous takeover is not proven.
